expected_transactions.note: read_cycle: one of ctrl_hum, ctrl_meas, hum_lsb, hum_msb, press_lsb, press_msb, press_xlsb, status, temp_lsb, temp_msb, temp_xlsb

test_stimuli.name: nominal_values
test_stimuli.derivation: temp: raw = (0x01 << 12) | (0x00 << 4) | (0x00 >> 4) = 4096; pressure: raw = (0x01 << 12) | (0x00 << 4) | (0x00 >> 4) = 4096; humidity: raw = (0x00 << 8) | 0x00 = 0; all returned as raw_count per B3.

test_stimuli.name: zero_values
test_stimuli.derivation: All raw values are zero: temp=0, pressure=0, humidity=0.

test_stimuli.name: max_values
test_stimuli.derivation: temp: raw = (0xFF << 12) | (0xFF << 4) | (0xF0 >> 4) = 0xFFFFF = 1048575; pressure: same = 1048575; humidity: raw = (0xFF << 8) | 0xFF = 65535.
